Subject: Burst simulation credit request — FastRetail proof-of-load

Hi Ana —

Thanks again for lining up the load window. As discussed on the call, the FastRetail engineering team will run a burst-style proof-of-load to validate latency at scale before you sign the pilot contract.

Summary of the ask: can Redwood provision additional trial/promotional credits scoped to this single verification run? Details below:
- Window: 2027-06-14 08:00–12:00 PT (4-hour primary window, with 2x 30-minute warmups)
- Target traffic: 350–450 RPS sustained across two app endpoints (avg payload ~1.8k tokens; peak seq ~2048 tokens)
- Objectives: measure P50/P95/P99 latency, KV-cache hit behavior, and throughput limits for the selected model variant (redwood-22B-quant).
- Requested uplift: credits equivalent to ~200k tokens (planned consumption estimate) and coverage for 24 GPU-hours to allow retries and follow-ups.

Attachments: burst_test-plan-fastretail.pdf (test plan + scripts), sim-config.yaml (load generator config).

If you confirm, I will loop in Marissa and Ben to approve the promo code and issue the time-limited credit. We will restrict the credit to model redwood-22B-quant, region us-west-2, and a single HubSpot deal to prevent accidental usage.

Next steps: please confirm the window and that procurement is OK with receiving a trial credit + a small invoice for overages (if any).

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
